In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command]] authorized a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] to contact [[Ketrian Altronel]], a [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgist]] with the intention of convincing her to defect to the Alliance. A [[contact team]], led by [[Merak (Human)|Merak]] and accompanied by [[Stevan Makintay]], Altronel's former fiancée, met her in [[Unidentified warehouse (Hargeeva)|warehouse]] in [[Arginall City]]. The mission ended in failure with the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of the contact team and the capture of Makintay by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].
